log_file.description: Path to log file. Empty string means logging to stderr/stdout only.

pin_cache.description: PIN cache expiration period in seconds. 0 means no caching.

use_gnupg_pin_cache.description: Use GnuPG's built-in PIN cache (requires gnupg >= 2.3.0).

providers.description: List of provider names (must be non-empty if using PKCS#11).

provider_settings.description: Per-provider configuration. Each item is a provider name key with nested attributes (used with providers list). Flat structure required per schema rules, so this is represented as a list of provider names with separate provider_settings_[name] fields below.

provider_settings_p1_library.description: Full path to PKCS#11 library for provider 'p1'.

provider_settings_p1_cert_private.description: Require authentication before accessing certificates for provider 'p1'.

provider_settings_p1_private_mask.description: Private key mask mode for provider 'p1'. 0=auto, 1=force sign, 2=sign with recovery, 4=decrypt, 8=decrypt unwrap.

openpgp_keys_sign.description: SHA1 hash (uppercase hex, no spaces) of signing key for gnupg-2.0 to <2.1.19.

openpgp_keys_encr.description: SHA1 hash (uppercase hex, no spaces) of encryption key for gnupg-2.0 to <2.1.19.

openpgp_keys_auth.description: SHA1 hash (uppercase hex, no spaces) of authentication key for gnupg-2.0 to <2.1.19.
